item_short_desc: Show off your inner Spartan with the Rothco Molon Labe Morale Patch; featuring an embroidered "Molon Labe" text. The morale patches feature a hook backing which makes it ideal for attaching to our Special Ops Jackets, Transport Packs, Tactical Vest and more.
